title: Image delivery vs QoS reliability (synthetic images, two processes)
dataset: synthetic rgb8 images generated by probe.py
conclusion: With the default RMW on the development laptop, best-effort subscriptions lose most large RGB images across processes; reliable subscriptions receive all of them. Camera nodes default to reliable QoS (configurable).
limitations: Single run per combination, synthetic images, development laptop only.
Must be repeated with the real RealSense driver and on the lab PC.
Within a single process, all combinations delivered 150/150 images.
